newsitem.title: USA: Carriers face uphill battle to lift rates - analysts.
newsitem.headline: Carriers face uphill battle to lift rates - analysts.

text.p: A move by some of the world's leading container ship companies to raise rates on trans-Pacific cargo has some U.S. importers worried, but industry analysts say ocean carriers will have trouble making any agreement stick.
Freight rates on imports of goods from the Far East have fallen by up to 20 percent in the past year and a half, hurt by a steady increase in newer and larger container ships on the market.
